limitations.limitation: Preview-only evidence does not prove apply safety; rollback is not needed unless a source mutation is applied.

claims.warrant: Executed command evidence, not recommendation text, determines this claim; check success without selected command evidence is not enough.

claims.claim: Selected command evidence remains structurally distinct from recommended command advice.
claims.warrant: Selected and recommended commands are represented as separate fields; overlapping command strings are allowed when recommendations were intentionally selected.

claims.claim: Graph or impact evidence includes visible limitations.
claims.warrant: Missing or fallback-shaped graph evidence qualifies continuation decisions; it does not imply no impact.

claims.claim: Snapshot artifact references are not materialized local proof.
claims.warrant: Artifact references must distinguish materialized local files from ephemeral snapshot pointers, missing files, unsupported URIs, and path escapes.

claims.claim: Rollback is not needed because no source mutation was applied.
claims.warrant: Rollback availability requires a command or materialized inverse patch; preview-only evidence does not need rollback because it does not mutate source.

claims.claim: Applied diff verification is not recorded for this review.
claims.warrant: Applied mutation evidence must preserve whether the applied diff matched the reviewed snapshot; mismatch blocks apply-safety claims.

claims.claim: This evidence remains preview-only and does not prove apply safety.
claims.warrant: Preview evidence can support continued review, not production readiness or governance acceptance.
